name: Workforce.com
summary: Workforce.com sells Scheduling, Payroll, HR and All-in-One bundles, and every plan on the pricing page reads Request Pricing. Licensing is per user, with discounts tied to module count, contract length and billing terms. The scheduling page lists drag-and-drop building, templates, shift swapping and an iOS and Android app.

facts.text: Per the pricing FAQ, licensing is per user for the bundle selected, and prices depend on modules, staff count and implementation needs.
The scheduling page says shifts can be scheduled to employee availability and lists Availability and Unavailability as a feature, without saying how employees submit it.
Staff can find their own replacements through shift swapping and shift bidding, according to the scheduling page.

plans.name: All-in-One
plans.notes: Scheduling, HR and payroll together; no amount published
